name: remote-pc-mcp
description: Reviews remote-pc-mcp's act tools. remote-pc-mcp is a self-hosted daemon that exposes a PC to MCP clients over streamable HTTP, usually inside a tailnet. Shell, process, file-write, download, screenshot and desktop-input tools are gated on review; read and status tools keep Guard's usual handling. Every install has its own endpoint, so this matches on the configured server name. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Bind the daemon to the host's Tailscale IP with REMOTE_PC_MCP_HOST so it is unreachable from outside the tailnet. Do not expose it publicly without TLS and a reverse proxy.
Keep shell_exec, start_process, kill_process, write_file and download_file on review: they run commands, end processes and change files on the host as the daemon user.
Keep click, move_mouse, type_text, press_key and scroll on review: they drive the host's live desktop session.
take_screenshot stays on review because it captures every monitor and the image lands in model context.
Treat the bearer token as a root-equivalent credential. Keep it only in the daemon's .env and the client's config.
